title: Medical Information Assistant
short: Drafts accurate answers to healthcare professionals’ product questions from approved sources only.
symptom: Doctors wait days for product answers
directions: Paste the inquiry. Get a draft answer built only from approved documents, with citations, for the medical information pharmacist to approve.
problem: Medical information teams answer many similar questions about dosing, stability, interactions and use in special populations, often searching the same documents again and again.
why: Slow or inconsistent answers frustrate prescribers and can affect patient care.
solution: Retrieves passages from approved documents, drafts a balanced answer with citations, and logs the inquiry; adverse events mentioned in an inquiry are routed to pharmacovigilance.
limitations: Answers only from approved sources; otherwise says it cannot answer
Every answer is approved by a pharmacist before sending
data: Approved product documents and standard response letters
review: A medical information pharmacist approves every answer before it is sent.
